svg.title: For finite labels D, let FD(Y ) sum Q i∈A pi over A ⊆D whose every overlap component meets Y , including the empty set, where pi = fieacB(Xi). In each component choose a label meeting Y and remove it. Every remaining component meets the removed support. Distinct original components choose distinct labels.
